name: Yuuya
source:
The protagonist. Since he was a small child, he has viewed his older sisters as members of the opposite sex.

However, his sisters don't know how he feels and play with him every day. He finally confesses his feelings to his older sisters when his patience runs out.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240711015600/http://chiroame.sakura.ne.jp/game/007/kyara.html] archived official site[/url]]
